constraints: Use functional components with typed props.
Derive state instead of synchronizing in effects.
Verify visual and interactive behavior with browser CDP or DOM assertions.
Validate inputs at the network boundary using schemas.
Keep business logic pure and free of framework transport types.
Never perform destructive column drops without a multi-phase migration.
Ensure every foreign key has an index.
Provide rollback scripts for all DDL changes.
Use set -euo pipefail in all bash scripts.
Support --help and standard POSIX exit codes.
Never hardcode personal home directory paths.
